about: Rankings: HLTV's Top 20 Players of the Year (2011, 2013-2015) and Esports Earnings' 2012 CS:GO prize money. Configs come from public archives of pro CS:GO configs (mostly game-written config.cfg files in setup.gg's GitHub archive, dated from timestamps inside them), each checked against its source; see each page for its sources.

years.note: A CS 1.6 ranking (CS:GO came out in August 2012), so these are the players' CS:GO configs from later, each labelled with its date.

The exact same value appears in GeT_RiGhT's and v1c7or's configs in setupgg/data, and v1c7or's config is clearly from a much later build (it has cl_crosshairstyle 4 and cl_operation_premium_reminder_op06). In setupgg/data, 223 of the 229 config.cfg files with a crosshair have cl_crosshairstyle. Only six lack it, and every one of those six has cl_dynamiccrosshair. The two of them that carry a timestamp (f0rest and GeT_RiGhT) show 2012-08-11 and 2012-08-14. The Skarbo crosshair generator committed on 2012-12-13 (e569127, javascript.js header comment) already lists "cl_crosshairstyle ( def. \"0\" )" as a game cvar. So the file was most likely saved between 2012-08-14 and about 2012-12-13. That last step is an inference. The firm latest date is the git commit, 2016-04-29 08:50 +0200 (setupgg/csgo a7612a6). I changed the date from "2012-08" to "2012" because August is only the earliest possible month.

config.date_basis: Changed from 2015. The file has no date, but its contents date it to about July to November 2014. (1) It contains cl_operation_premium_reminder_breakout and no op05 or op06 reminder. In Valve's items_game.txt (SteamDatabase mirror), the Operation Breakout pass (item 1027 'Community Season Four Summer 2014', icon operation_breakout_pass) has first_sale_date 2014/07/01, and the Operation Vanguard pass (item 1315, icon operation_vanguard_pass) has first_sale_date 2014/10/29. (2) In the setupgg/csgo corpus (commit 37f2920, about 50 pro config.cfg files), every file holds exactly one operation-reminder cvar. Where a reminder holds a Unix timestamp, breakout values fall between 2014-07-02 and 2014-08-05, op05 values between 2014-11-19 and 2015-01-04, and op06 values between 2015-05-26 and 2016-02-24. NBK's own later file swaps breakout for op06. So the game kept only the current operation's reminder cvar, and this file was saved after Breakout launched and before Vanguard's op05 cvar replaced it. (3) The in-game name is 'LDLC * NBKTANK-'. (4) Other bounds: player_medalstats_most_recent_time 1376339401 = 2013-08-12 is an earlier limit, and the first commit (e03e8c3, 2016-04-29 09:22 +0200) is the latest possible date. The earlier label of 2015 relied on the brief's 'LDLC until Feb 2015' and is not supported. A config saved in 2015 would hold the op05 cvar, not breakout.

The commit (setupgg/csgo a7612a6, 2016-04-29 08:50 +0200) only shows when it was uploaded, and setupgg replaced it with the 2013 file later that day. The op05 ones carry timestamps from 2014-11-19 (daps, 1416402469) onward. Operation Vanguard launched in the 2014-11-11 update notes. The file also lacks cl_crosshair_sniper_width, which was added on 2016-01-20.
